meta.method: Read named 2021 sources; one point per (source, location); pipeline/geocode.py inside AOI bbox, 1 req/s; manual neighbourhood centre only if Nominatim missed or matched the wrong district.
meta.notes: Quotes are verbatim excerpts ≤ 25 words. NiMet 125 mm Oshodi / 66 mm Ikeja are dated 15 July in TheCable/Punch (rainfall, not street flood). Magboro (Ogun) omitted. Taraba/Jalingo, Kano, Europe/China deaths in Punch omitted. Daily Trust 8,355 people / 12 LGAs not pinned to a street. NEMA LGA caution list is advisory, not confirmation of flooding. FloodList 50 cm is unlocated social-media depth. Jakande is Eti-Osa/Lekki, not Isolo. No locations, times, numbers or quotes were inferred beyond the text.
unresolved: Oju-Odo and Ekoro placed at Abule Egba/Agege neighbourhood centres (LASTMA named them; Nominatim missed)
Punch X photo captions not read
TheCable 22 Jul expert piece names no streets
omitted: NEMA 13-LGA caution list (Nairametrics; not named as flooded that day)
Fallen trucks at Iyana Isolo, Agbara, Oba Akran (Punch 17 Jul; not flood)
Daily Trust 24 Sep 2025 Lekki article (wrong event)

review.notes: All points inside AOI; same-name places (Jakande Isolo/Lekki, Ajegunle Ajeromi/Ikorodu) kept distinct; Ijede placed in Ijede town (Ikorodu LGA). Quotes verified for every readable publisher; Channels TV, TheCable, Guardian NG unverifiable (blocked).
